name: Demo Hotel
welcome: Welcome. I can help with hotel facilities, Wi-Fi, dining, checkout, and guest services.

quick_actions.label: Wi-Fi help
quick_actions.prompt: Can you help me with the hotel Wi-Fi?

quick_actions.label: Pool & gym
quick_actions.prompt: What are the pool and gym hours?

quick_actions.label: Nearby dining
quick_actions.prompt: Recommend good restaurants nearby that are open now.

knowledge.title: Breakfast
knowledge.answer: Breakfast is served from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM at the ground-floor restaurant.

knowledge.title: Checkout
knowledge.answer: Standard checkout is 12:00 PM. Late checkout is subject to availability and should be confirmed with the front desk.

knowledge.title: Pool
knowledge.answer: The swimming pool is open from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

knowledge.title: Gym
knowledge.answer: The fitness center is open 24 hours for registered hotel guests.

knowledge.title: Guest Wi-Fi
knowledge.answer: Connect to the hotel guest Wi-Fi and complete the guest authentication flow. If authentication fails, contact the front desk or hotel IT support.

knowledge.title: Housekeeping
knowledge.answer: Housekeeping requests can be sent to hotel staff. The prototype does not yet submit live service tickets, so please contact the front desk for urgent requests.

modes.label: Auto
modes.description: Escalates automatically for planning and live recommendations.

modes.label: Advanced
modes.description: Use a stronger model for complex requests.
